eligibility.quote:
The following commit fixed an issue with isnan for kinetic: https://github.com/yujinrobot/kobuki_core/commit/2d943e14e99d6d645729b97c5f6dcb10d415f8ff
Could we have that fix backported to indigo as well?

notes: Issue #22 ("Backport isnan fix to indigo") is a backport request plus maintainer confirmation (stonier: "Cherried in b166c939. Coming soon to indigo in v0.6.4."). I read the issue, the comment, and commit b166c93 ("[kobuki_driver] isnan -> std::isnan"), whose diff swaps `#include <stdexcept>` for `#include <cmath>` and changes `if (isnan(heading_offset) == true)` to `if (std::isnan(heading_offset) == true)` in Kobuki::spin(). The spec's E2 passes to step 6 (interface kind library API, api:isnan vs api:std::isnan), which I agree is the right stop point for E2: the referenced API symbol is a boundary-crossing name. But the case is ineligible because E3 and E4 fail: the source states no operation (which compiler/standard-library revision fails, on which platform, or what happens) and no effect (no failure, warning, or code-level statement of the mismatch — the commit and CHANGELOG name only the replacement "isnan -> std::isnan"). I agree with the overall ineligible decision and with stop_step=6 / reason_code=null at E2; the ineligibility arises at E3/E4, which the reason_code field does not capture. Loudness/resolution correctly null.
